title: Ruined Cliffside Stage
description: A dilapidated stone platform with broken columns, wooden scaffolding, and tattered red curtains sits on the edge of a crumbling cliff glowing with yellow cracks. In the background, a vast fantasy landscape unfolds with purple mountains, a distant castle on a cliff, a stormy sea, and flying creatures under a dramatic twilight sky with swirling golden patterns.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of an ancient ruined stone stage perched on a crumbling cliff edge with glowing yellow cracks, broken marble columns, red curtains, and wooden scaffolding. In the distance, a majestic castle sits atop a cliff across a stormy sea with purple mountains behind it. Dramatic twilight sky with swirling golden patterns and flying creatures. Papers floating in the wind, epic melancholic atmosphere.
